response.rationale: Reach jumped 5 standard deviations while CPM and OSA are unflagged (z=0.0) and the own-action confound flag is false. A flat CPM rules out a price/competition-driven move, and no own bid/budget change is showing up in the data, so the clean 5σ reach surge reads as a genuine demand shift (more auctions/impressions) rather than a harness confound or noise.
